metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the IGES CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with all source under `output/`. I also added symlinks so it runs as `node main.js ...` and `./iges ...`.

The tool supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, emits the required JSON envelopes on failure, writes 80-column fixed-format IGES, parses Global/DE/PD/T sections with Hollerith handling and custom delimiters, validates the required Global fields and DE cross-references, and evaluates the supported parametric curves and surfaces including rational B-splines.

I smoke-tested:
- `write -> parse -> eval` on a Line entity
- custom Global delimiters
- Rational B-spline curve eval
- Rational B-spline surface eval
- `roundtrip` fixed-point stability across two passes

Key files are [output/parser.js](/workspace/output/parser.js), [output/writer.js](/workspace/output/writer.js), [output/entities.js](/workspace/output/entities.js), and [output/evaluator.js](/workspace/output/evaluator.js).
